$comment: Which sample plays which notes. Each entry: `file` (a 16-bit PCM mono WAV in assets/), `root` (the key it sounds unpitched at), `keys` (the lowest and highest key it plays), `velocity` (the lowest and highest velocity, 0 to 1: two entries on the same keys are velocity layers) and `loop` (the frames the Loop mode repeats, start and end; absent: the whole sample). The first entry that matches a note plays it. After changing this file or a WAV, run `node tools/embed-samples.mjs`: it writes the samples into the module's source (an EST module reads no files at run time).
